6eh's **Stop hook** fired and prompted it to re-scan for unfiled follow-ups. It correctly identified that the sentence the hook flagged was a valid skip — `o26` and `201` are already in the queue, and it was reporting their status rather than deferring new work. But the prompt made it re-scan anyway, and it found **an unfiled follow-up it had noticed early and silently dropped — one its own change made worse**: `docs/BUILD_AND_CI.md` cites `tox.ini` by line number (`:27`, `:36`, `:52-53`), and its change edits `tox.ini`, so those references may now point at the wrong lines.
